name: capsule-estimator
description: Designed by Capsule. Turns a proposal scope into a grounded, range-based estimate — hours and price by discipline — built from Capsule's own signed history (the Proposals Index, Pricing Reference, and Discipline Hours Benchmark in Notion). Cites the nearest comparable past jobs, carries a confidence label on every number, and applies Capsule's win-rate guardrails (the $50K line, the 3-discipline rule). Needs the Notion connector.
